longDescription: Eleven skills for managing the gap between a plan and the actual code, domain, and constraints. Investigate blind spots, learn vocabulary, clarify requirements through interviews, compare prototypes and interventions, analyze references, plan changeable decisions first, record deviations, prepare review documents, and check understanding with a quiz. The loop skill connects these methods. This upload contains skills and their shared page template; Claude Code hooks and specialist agents are distributed only in the Claude plugin.
capabilities: Investigate blind spots and improve the implementation prompt
Turn vague requirements into decisions and contrasting options
Plan, record deviations, prepare review, and check understanding
defaultPrompt: Use unknowns:blindspot to investigate what I am missing before this migration.
Use unknowns:interview to clarify requirements before implementing this feature.
Use unknowns:quiz to check my understanding of the changes before review.
